Markets.title: US Fed's Michael Barr warns central bank may need to raise rates if inflation stays high
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr stated the central bank may need to raise interest rates if inflation remains high. Future monetary policy decisions will depend on incoming economic data.

Markets.title: Struggling GoPro sells majority stake to optical maker Starman for $285 million
Markets.summary: Starman Optical is acquiring a majority stake in GoPro for $285 million in cash to help pay off debt and integrate new optical technology. The deal is expected to close by the end of the year while keeping GoPro's consumer business operational.

Markets.title: US Treasury bond yields ease from highs after data as Iran war escalation fans inflation concerns
Markets.summary: U.S. Treasury yields retreated from earlier highs following the release of August manufacturing PMI and job opening data. Meanwhile, surging oil prices driven by Middle East conflict renewed global inflation concerns and raised Federal Reserve rate hike expectations.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields are rising — Why does it matter?
Markets.summary: Rising U.S. Treasury yields are increasing borrowing costs for households, businesses, and governments. This rise leads to higher mortgage and auto loan rates, which can reduce consumer spending and strain financial markets globally.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Acme Solar, BEML among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian markets remained volatile above 24,000 due to crude prices and geopolitical tensions. Analysts recommended Acme Solar, BEML, KSB, and City Union Bank based on bullish technical patterns and breakouts.

Markets.title: US bond yields reflect 'flat to down' inflation expectations, stronger growth, Bessent says
Markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that current bond yields indicate stable or declining inflation expectations and strong economic growth. He shared these insights during a finance leaders' gathering in Asheville alongside Group of discussions.

Geo-Political.title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
Geo-Political.summary: Germany stated that Russia was responsible for a drone carrying an explosive device that was found near Ukrainian cargo planes at the Leipzig airport on August 4. German authorities confirmed the incident is currently under investigation as a targeted act of sabotage.

Geo-Political.title: US launches more strikes on Iran as state media reports explosions
Geo-Political.summary: The US military launched airstrikes against Iran after US Central Command accused the country of attacking commercial shipping and American service members in the region. Meanwhile, Iranian state media reported explosions resulting from the strikes.

Geo-Political.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
Geo-Political.summary: Over six million people have been forced to deport back to Afghanistan, where many have never lived before. This mass displacement is driven by ongoing expulsions from neighboring Pakistan and Iran under Taliban rule.

Geo-Political.title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nepal's death toll has exceeded 1,000 as rescue efforts continue for hydropower workers following a severe disaster. A surviving worker told the BBC that river water smashed into a tunnel and chased him for 20 minutes.

Geo-Political.title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
Geo-Political.summary: Prosecutors in the Spanish exclave of Ceuta report that sexual assaults are occurring almost daily among the remaining migrant population. While most migrants have returned to neighboring Morocco, approximately 5,000 migrants still remain in the territory.

Geo-Political.title: Jurors in Lindsay Clancy trial deadlocked but judge asks them to keep trying
Geo-Political.summary: Jurors deliberating the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, a Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three children in 2023, are currently deadlocked. The judge has instructed the jury to continue trying to reach a verdict.

Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr stated that the central bank needs to increase interest rates if inflation does not drop toward the 2% target. He emphasized that monetary policy must remain responsive to ongoing price pressures.

Data & Insights.title: India's current account widens marginally in April-June, RBI data shows
Data & Insights.summary: India's current account deficit increased slightly in the April-to-June quarter compared to the previous year. The Reserve Bank of India reported that this growth was driven by higher commodity prices and a wider trade gap.

Data & Insights.title: Russia cuts expected 2026 oil output to 17-year low, says report; what it means for India
Data & Insights.summary: Russia has reduced its projected 2026 oil production to a 17-year low. Meanwhile, rising crude exports and strong purchases by India are keeping the spotlight on Moscow's key Asian oil market.

Data & Insights.title: Centre slashes sugar dealers’ stock limit to 2,000 quintals from 15 September
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced the stock limit for sugar dealers to 2,000 quintals starting 15 September. This measure aims to maintain adequate domestic sugar supplies and stable prices ahead of the festive season.

Data & Insights.title: Q1 GDP growth beats expectations: Are foreign investors underestimating India's resilience?
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q1 GDP grew by a better-than-expected 7.8%, driven by strong investment and fiscal improvements. This resilient economic performance challenges foreign skepticism regarding geopolitical tensions and oil price concerns.

Data & Insights.title: GST collections rise 14.8% to  ₹1.99 trillion in August; refunds jump 68%
Data & Insights.summary: India's Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections rose 14.8% year-on-year to ₹1.99 trillion in August, while tax refunds jumped by 68%. Although August collections were lower than July's ₹2.11 trillion, they mark the second time collections crossed the ₹2 trillion threshold.

India.title: Actor Duniya Vijay's Son Accused Of Assaulting Student For Overtaking In Bengaluru
India.summary: Actor Duniya Vijay's son, Samrat, and his friends allegedly abducted and assaulted a student named Manish outside RV University in Bengaluru. The attack reportedly occurred after Manish overtook the suspects' vehicle.

India.title: UP Shock Loading For Asaduddin Owaisi? Sources Say Big Exit Upcoming
India.summary: Syed Asim Waqar is expected to leave Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM party after nearly a decade of service. He will join the Congress party in Delhi on Wednesday, dealing a significant blow to the AIMIM.

India.title: Inside Modi's Balancing Act at the SCO: Xi, Putin, and a Pointed Message for Pakistan
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi balanced India's foreign relations by engaging with Russia, China, and Central Asian leaders at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit without aligning with any specific bloc. This diplomatic approach allowed India to maintain its strategic autonomy while participating in regional cooperation.

India.title: Punjab Sacked Police Officer Over Lawrence Bishnoi Jail Interview. HC Quashes Dismissal Order
India.summary: The Punjab High Court has quashed the dismissal of a DSP who was sacked over a televised jail interview of gangster Lawrence Bishnoi. A probe had previously alleged that one of the interviews was conducted in September 2022 inside a Mohali police station where the officer was present.

India.title: AI Video War In UP: Akhilesh Yadav's 'Chillum' Dig Angers BJP, He Doubles Down
India.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav shared a manipulated video depicting a theft at a temple to target Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. The BJP strongly condemned the post, defending Adityanath's status as a saint, while Yadav doubled down on his criticism.

India.title: Ahmedabad Student Calculates Time Across 120 Countries In 5 Minutes, Sets World Record
India.summary: A student from Ahmedabad, Gujarat, set a world record by calculating the time across 120 countries in just five minutes. This accomplishment adds to the growing list of young achievers from the region receiving recognition for exceptional skills.

General.title: UK long-term borrowing costs highest since 1998 ahead of October Budget
General.summary: UK long-term borrowing costs have risen to their highest level since 1998. This increase creates additional financial pressure ahead of the upcoming October Budget.

General.summary: Keir Starmer has announced his resignation as a Member of Parliament. This decision will trigger a by-election in his London constituency.

General.title: Watch: Norway's new king takes oath as mourners pay respects to his late father
General.summary: Norway's new king has taken his official oath of reign. Meanwhile, mourners are paying their respects to his late father, King Harald V, as he lies in state at the Royal Palace.

General.title: Baby girl who died at Sheffield house was stabbed, police say
General.summary: A baby girl who was pronounced dead at a property in Sheffield was stabbed, police confirm.
